name: Photo-print app film: one container morphs from wordmark to dot to pill to aperture to frame (square)

brand_assets.description: Product wordmark with a full stop and tagline
App screens, glass playback controls, lock screen and web shop
Hands holding the frame (footage or render)

rights.notes: Rights unverified. App launch; reuse the container-morph chain, punctuation-to-button and bloom principles only, with original shapes, imagery and copy.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, Session C) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (39 frames), transition strips at all 10 boundaries, the listen sheet (11 accent hits; no speech) and a 30 fps strip at 0.70-1.90 s (wordmark to dot to pill); automated audio and listen metrics (signal features; nothing was listened to).

concept.observed: An app that turns phone photos into framed prints: the wordmark collapses into its full stop, the dot becomes a 'Develop' button, a click opens an aperture onto a photo, a grid of images, one image fills the frame, glass playback controls and a 'golden hour' slider relight it, a lens bubble opens the next image, a phone lock screen, the image moves from the phone into a desktop shop, a print is ordered, framed on a wall, held in hands, and the film closes back into the wordmark.
concept.interpreted: Screen to wall as one unbroken object journey.

communication_style.observed: No voice; almost no copy (wordmark, a tagline, one landing-page headline, UI labels).

palette.observed: Warm off-white; black for the pill, aperture and frames; the photographs supply all colour (golden hour, sage green); a blue silk backdrop for the device section.

typography.observed: Heavy rounded grotesque wordmark in lowercase with a full stop; tiny UI type; one landing-page headline in the same heavy face.

composition.observed: Square; one object centred at a time; devices centred on the silk backdrop; the print centred on a wall.

motion.observed: Directional smear as the wordmark collapses (0.70-0.87 s) and as the dot stretches into a pill (1.17-1.40 s); a button press (2.0-2.1 s); aperture blades (2.6 s); one tile splits into a grid (3.7-4.1 s); a slider drags and the light in the photo changes (9.1-9.5 s); a cursor picks frame, size and Order; a progress pill; the frame flips onto the wall.

transitions.observed: No hard cuts (10 soft boundaries). Container morphs carry each change: the wordmark into its own full stop (0.70-0.87 s), dot to pill (1.17-1.40 s), aperture circle to rounded tile (2.96-3.29 s), grid tile to full frame (5.79-5.92 s), full frame into a phone screen (13.15-13.32 s), a black panel into a browser window (14.72-14.89 s). A glass lens bubble holding the next image grows to fill the frame (10.97-11.14 s); the checked Order button grows into a black frame (21.73-21.86 s); a push into the framed print until the picture fills the frame (25.46-25.69 s); a hexagonal iris closes to a point on black (26.46-26.56 s); a black pill opens back into the wordmark at the end (27.2-27.9 s).
transitions.interpreted: One object never leaves: every scene is a new shape of the same container, so 29 s of product steps read as one gesture.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Changes every 1.6-2.7 s, with one longer device-and-shop section (14.8-21.8 s).

sound_design.observed: -14.1 LUFS, LRA 2.0 LU, true peak -0.3 dBTP; tempo 80.7 bpm (medium); 31 accents (64.1/min) at irregular spacing (0.11-1.0 s); 2 of 10 boundaries carry an accent within 100 ms (0.20, at chance 0.19); 50% within 50 ms of an onset (chance 0.41); near the beat 0.10 (chance 0.16). The strongest accents land on the container's shape changes: the wordmark collapsing into the dot (0.86 s), the dot stretching into the pill (1.60-1.74 s), the button press (2.00-2.11 s), the circle becoming a tile (3.11 s), the tiles splitting into a grid (3.85-4.11 s); later on the glass controls (7.62-9.61 s) and the move into the phone (12.61-13.61 s). Head 2.2 dB below the body, tail 0.5 dB above; no silences. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Sound marks each change of the object's shape; the soft boundaries are not hit.

narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: No captions. Copy: the wordmark centred with a tiny tagline under it (0-0.6 s and 27.9-29 s), the label inside the pill, and one landing-page headline ('from screen to wall.') inside the browser card at 16.7 s; UI labels.

scenes.observed: The wordmark collapses into a dot; the dot becomes a 'Develop' pill; a click.
An aperture opens onto a photo; the circle becomes a rounded tile.
The tile splits into a grid of photographs.
One photo fills the frame; glass controls and a 'golden hour' slider relight it.
A lens bubble opens the next image; a lock screen.
The frame shrinks into a phone on a silk backdrop.
The image moves into a desktop shop; frame, size and Order; 'On its way'.
Black, then the print framed on a wall and held in hands.
A push into the print; an iris closes to black.
A black pill opens back into the wordmark.

moments.observed: The wordmark smears to the right and collapses into its own full stop in about 0.17 s; the dot holds 0.27 s, then stretches into the 'Develop' pill (1.17-1.40 s).
moments.interpreted: The brand's punctuation becomes the product's first button.

difficult: Hands holding the framed print (23.4-25.5 s) look like footage or a photoreal render
The glass lens and liquid-glass controls need layered blur and refraction (backdrop-filter is costly at 720p)
uncertainties: Whether the frame-on-wall shots are footage, renders or composited stills
Easing of the morphs (one 30 fps strip; the rest at 2-frame steps)

sampling.cut_refinement: every frame inside the coarse step
